page.overview:
What is Confusion?

Confusion is the seventh song from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

The song explores the concept of PTSD. The narrator is a soldier who suffers from it and describes how it affects their life, preventing them from living normally, in a constant struggle with insanity.

Wake to face the day Grab this life and walk away War is never done Rub the patch and battle on Make it go away Please make it go away

Confusion All sanity is now beyond me Delusion All sanity is but a memory My life… The war that never ends
